aggregation: Counts pool correlated annotation frames descriptively; qualification gates remain equal-excerpt macro means.

audit_specification.boundary_distance: For each reference-unvoiced annotation find nearest preceding/following known voiced annotation; nearest absolute time gap. Bins <=.05s,(.05,.10],(.10,.20],>.20; missing voiced neighbors gives infinite distance. For false negatives use nearest known unvoiced annotation analogously. Unknown annotations never become transitions or scored frames. Report unknown and unmatched annotations and absent preceding/following opposite-state neighbors explicitly; these distances are censored by clip endpoints.
audit_specification.categories: For FP within.20s of voice classify post-offset if preceding voice nearest, pre-onset if following nearest, ties post-offset; farther FP are interior-rest. These annotation proximity categories do not establish causes.
audit_specification.outputs: Per excerpt/singer/condition counts and unchanged scoring; pooled descriptive FP/FN boundary bins, predictor medians and quantiles for TP/FP/FN; paired identical-reference solo/mixture FP co-occurrence; high-score FP defined p>=.9 and interior-rest; persist6 longest contiguous actual-v8 FP runs of >=.20s (ties key then start), predictions/reference/predictors and paired solo/mixture context, PNG traces and original solo waveform excerpts where available. Contiguous runs split at unknown/non-FP annotations and timestamp gaps greater than1.5 times the median positive annotation step; duration includes one such median step.
audit_specification.scope: Post-selection descriptive audit of all54 singing outer-held streams; cannot alter labels, models, thresholds, or advancement. Compare actual v8 selected/fallback decisions with fixed diagnostic .50 and .75 anchors using same outer models. Both anchors are descriptive, not candidate choices. Compare the direct .50 masks with retained v7 DP fallback masks separately to quantify comparator-only differences.
audit_specification.scope_limits: No auditory classification claim, no automatic relabeling, no inferred instrumental leakage from diagnostics alone. Original solo waveform context and paired-error patterns distinguish pre-existing source residual from mixture-associated error only descriptively; separator causality remains unresolved.
